item.summary: fix(gateway): detect merged PR heads beyond the session PR display cap (#119204) fetchBranchPullRequests fetches per_page=5 PRs for a branch but built the merged-head list used by landing detection from the display-capped slice of 3. A squash-merged PR sorted outside the cap was dropped, so the Control UI could show a duplicate Create PR invitation for work that already landed. Compute merged heads from the full fetched list. Co-authored-by: Peter Steinberger
